text:
If you’re heading out for sunset, you should get a clear view in Burlington, though a few high clouds will start drifting in before the 6:17 show. Tonight stays dry and partly cloudy, with temperatures easing toward 45. The lake will be a different story, south winds building to 15 to 20 knots with 1 to 3-foot waves, so keep any waterfront plans close to shore.

Tomorrow starts fairly friendly, partly sunny with a high somewhere between 59 and 68, and I’d split the difference near 63. The south wind will be noticeable at 12 to 15 knots, clouds thicken through the afternoon, and rain becomes likely after 8pm. The models are unusually far apart on how warm Sunday gets, but they agree on the evening turn. Enjoy the daylight hours, then have the rain jacket ready for Sunday night.
